_comment: These are hard numeric limits. Claude's reasoning/thesis step may NEVER override these values. Any proposed trade that violates a rule here must be rejected before it reaches the broker, with no exceptions regardless of how strong the thesis sounds.
broker_note: All market data, account state, and orders go through moomoo's hosted MCP server (https://mcp.moomoo.com/mcp). Symbols are written in moomoo's 'US.AAPL' form throughout the pipeline; the bare ticker ('AAPL') is what gets logged as 'symbol'.

accounts.note: live_acc_id comes from account_authorized_trd_accs (the real securities account with enable_market including 2 = U.S.). paper_acc_id and paper_market_id come from sim_trade_account_list (the U.S. simulated-trading account; market_id 100 = US_STOCK). Phase B reads positions/funds from, and sends orders to, exactly one of these per run, chosen by execution.mode below -- never both.

execution.note: mode is one of 'dry_run' (log only -- no order is sent anywhere, state is read from the paper account), 'paper' (orders are actually placed on the moomoo SIMULATED account via sim_trade_input_order -- fake money, real fills, the recommended starting point), or 'live' (orders are placed on the real account via trading_order_place). Only the human may change this value. Claude must never change it, and must never call trading_order_place while mode is not 'live'.
execution.paper_min_cycles_note: Distinct dates with a cycle_summary whose mode is 'dry_run' or 'paper' must reach this count before the live-order gate (PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 6/8) can open.

order_execution.note: moomoo's order API takes a share quantity, not a dollar amount, so every buy is floor(dollar_amount / ask) whole shares and every partial sell is floor(quantity) -- see scripts/position_sizing.py --ask-price and scripts/take_profit.py --whole-shares. A buy whose floored quantity is 0 is skipped (logged, never rounded up). on_need_order_confirm = 'reject' means: if trading_order_place returns need_order_confirm = true, Claude must NOT call trading_order_confirm -- log the prompt verbatim and treat the order as rejected, so a broker-side risk warning is always surfaced to the human rather than auto-acknowledged by an unattended run.

universe.watchlist_note: The moomoo watchlist group name as shown in the app (quote_user_security_group lists them; quote_user_security pulls one by group_name).
universe.supplementary_screen_note: Passed verbatim as quote_stock_screen's screen_queries (AND of all elements). The default is U.S. market (simple_field 1 = MARKET, value 2 = US) plus market cap 2B-50B (property 2301 = mktcap x 1e3, so values are pre-scaled by 1000). Add whatever relative-volume / RSI / change-rate conditions you like per moomoo's screener docs, then validate the whole array once by hand in a normal Claude session before relying on it. Additive to watchlist_max_candidates, not shared with it.

signal_thresholds._comment: A Step-1 candidate qualifies for a Phase A news search + thesis (i.e. counts as a 'notable signal') if it meets ANY ONE of these three, computed by scripts/screen_metrics.py from the daily K-line series already pulled in Step 1 (no extra API calls). This is a mechanical gate, not a judgment call. Currently-held positions are exempt and always get a thesis regardless of these thresholds.

position_sizing.min_top_up_note: A top-up only fires if the computed buy amount clears max($1.00 broker minimum, min_top_up_usd, min_top_up_pct_of_target x target_size for that candidate's conviction tier) AND floors to at least one whole share. Below that, skip without sending an order -- a top-up smaller than this doesn't move the position meaningfully, and letting headroom shrink toward zero every cycle otherwise generates a long tail of dust-sized orders as the position converges on target. Applies to top-ups only, never to new-entry sizing.

stop_loss.note: mode is 'fixed' or 'volatility_scaled' -- toggle only. 'fixed' uses the flat hard_stop_pct for every symbol. 'volatility_scaled': stop_pct per symbol = clamp(volatility_stdev_multiplier * stdev of daily close-to-close returns over volatility_lookback_trading_days, min_stop_pct, max_stop_pct), recomputed fresh from quote_history_kline each cycle; falls back to fallback_stop_pct if K-lines are unavailable or the symbol has fewer than 10 daily bars. Every open position must have this stop checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock. A good new narrative does not cancel a stop-loss.

take_profit.note: Tiered partial take-profit, not a single full-exit threshold. Every open position must have this checked on every cycle, independent of any new thesis about the stock -- this account is short-term oriented, not buy-and-hold. A good new narrative does not cancel a take-profit tier any more than it cancels a stop-loss. Each tier fires once (per holding period, i.e. since the position last closed to zero) when gain first reaches it, selling sell_fraction_of_position of the position's quantity at that moment, floored to whole shares -- see PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 5 for the exact mechanics. After all three tiers have fired, the remaining quantity is held long indefinitely; only the stop-loss still applies to it. See sell_reentry_lock for re-entry lock behavior.

conviction_trim.note: Trims a held position to its conviction-tier target once conviction has been 'low' or 'medium' (i.e. not 'high') for min_overweight_conviction_cycles consecutive cycles and the overage exceeds overweight_trigger_pct -- see scripts/conviction_trim.py. See sell_reentry_lock for re-entry lock behavior.

sell_reentry_lock.note: Applies to every sell reason: a loss-closed sell locks re-entry until price drops below the sale price; a gain-closed sell locks until price drops below the sale price or gain_close_max_trading_days trading days pass, whichever comes first. See scripts/entry_gate.py.

loss_limits.note: Realized daily/weekly P&L is computed by scripts/realized_pnl.py from this pipeline's own confirmed sell fills in trade_log.jsonl (the account is dedicated to this pipeline, so its log is the complete trade record). net_deposits_usd comes from account_cash_logs (live) or sim_trade_cash_info (paper/dry_run) -- see PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 7.

wash_sale_avoidance.note: Toggle only -- set enabled to false to turn this guard off entirely; no other change needed. IRS wash-sale rule applies per taxpayer across ALL accounts, not per account, so this checks linked_acc_ids, not just the trading account. Blocks BUYS only (new entries and top-ups) -- never blocks a stop_loss/take_profit/exit_existing sell, since risk management must never bend to a tax outcome; those sells are instead logged with a wash-sale flag if one applies, for the human's own tax tracking. For the pipeline's own account, loss sales come from trade_log.jsonl; for every other acc_id listed here, ANY sell fill of the symbol inside the window (account_fills_history) is conservatively treated as a possible loss sale, since fill history alone doesn't carry cost basis. This cannot prevent a wash sale caused by a purchase made LATER in another linked account after an agentic-account sell -- those accounts are outside this pipeline's control; only the human can avoid that side. Non-resident filers: the rule may not apply to you at all -- ask a tax professional, and set enabled to false if it doesn't.

entry_price_gap.note: Hard ceiling on buys -- a gap this large skips the buy this cycle even if the thesis still reads fine, same principle as a stop-loss. Never applies to sells. Checked in Phase B Step 7's buy gate -- not part of the execution.mode live-order gate.

entry_extension.note: Hard ceiling on buys -- skips the buy this cycle if current_price is more than max_extension_pct above its own lookback_trading_days-day moving average, same principle as entry_price_gap. Never applies to sells.

earnings_blackout.note: Skips new entries and top-ups when the symbol's next earnings report is within blackout_trading_days trading days (0 = today), so fresh money isn't put on a binary event. Never applies to sells. moomoo's MCP has no single next-earnings-date tool, so Phase B sources the date per PHASE_B_TASK.md Step 7 (company IR / press release via news_search or web search); a date that can't be confirmed is logged as unknown and does NOT block the buy -- see README 'Known gaps'.

early_exit_guard.note: Within window_trading_days of a holding period's opening buy, an exit_existing sell requires a new_fact_date after the entry thesis's date -- a thesis can't reverse on facts it already had. Never blocks stop_loss/take_profit/conviction_trim.
